description: From the category (e.g. packaging, logistics, cleaning, IT, electronics, chemicals, wood and paper, textiles, food, energy, construction) it compiles the matching questions: six base questions for every supplier (code of conduct, working conditions in the supply chain, environmental management, greenhouse gas data, integrity, contact person) plus modules per category, each with the evidence to ask for. With a supplier's answers it lists unanswered questions, answers without evidence and answers that were no, as topics for the supplier meeting. No rating, no seal, not legal advice. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

answers.description: Optional supplier answers: id (e.g. B1), answer, evidence (yes/no or name of the document).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: esg_questionnaire
title: Sustainability evidence questions for suppliers by category, and a check of the answers against required evidence (no rating, no seal)
